title: Automatic ICP Ledger Payment Verification & Account Activation - Frontend

requirements.summary: Update PaymentGate to trigger automatic payment verification via verifyAndActivate() with loading, success, and error states
acceptanceCriteria: PaymentGate shows a 'Check Payment' button that calls the backend verifyAndActivate() function.
A spinner / loading indicator is displayed while the verification call is in flight.
On success (account activated), the gate disappears and the user is taken to the main dashboard.
On failure, a user-friendly English error message is shown explaining that no payment was detected yet.
The existing 30-second polling for activation status remains active so the UI also auto-unlocks if payment is verified by another trigger.
The ICP receiving address eadaef90a0208bf42e25d15b9d99b767e72ed66ed1fab5b66a7799bfe88283c0 is displayed as the payment destination (used as default when no admin-configured address is set).

file_operations.description: Add a 'Check Payment' button below the payment address display that triggers the verifyAndActivate mutation. Show a loading spinner while the mutation is in progress. On success, display a success message (the gate will auto-dismiss via the existing 30s polling). On error, show a user-friendly message like 'No payment found yet — please wait a moment and try again.' Use the useVerifyAndActivateMutation hook from useActivationQueries. The existing polling mechanism (useActivationStatus with refetchInterval: 30000) continues to work in parallel. Preserve the admin-only ICP address editor panel. Use the authorization component to guard admin-only features as required.

requirements.summary: Add verifyAndActivate React Query mutation to useActivationQueries for frontend components
acceptanceCriteria: The mutation calls actor.verifyAndActivate() and invalidates the activation-status query on success.
TypeScript types are correctly inferred from the backend Candid interface.

file_operations.description: Export a new useVerifyAndActivateMutation hook using useMutation from @tanstack/react-query. The mutation should call actor.verifyAndActivate() and return the boolean result. On success, invalidate the queryKeys.activation.status query so the UI refetches activation state immediately. On error, return a descriptive error message. Import the backend actor via useActor and ensure the mutation is only enabled when the actor is available. Use toast notifications for user feedback (success or error).
